title: Propose / diff / apply workflow
goal: AI mutates the tree only through CLI proposals; user approves diffs before persistence.

claims.text: `propose <project> <op> ... --no-prompt` writes `*.proposed` and prints a unified diff without modifying the live tree file
claims.rationale: Core safety gate — AI authors, CLI stages

claims.text: `apply <project>` promotes `*.proposed` to the target yaml and deletes the pending file; `reject` deletes pending without applying
A second `propose` while pending fails with an error directing user to apply or reject first
claims.rationale: No silent overwrite of in-flight proposals

claims.text: `propose --fragment fragments/foo.yaml` stages mutations against that fragment file (same apply/reject/pending flags)
claims.rationale: Fragment-aware workflow documented in project-tree skill

claims.text: project-tree SKILL.md documents the mandatory workflow: show → propose --no-prompt → user y/n → apply/reject
